records.title: Eight source histories survive the final two labels
Ām retains primary ṇic and auxiliary identity
Caṅ shortening retains puk or root-owned y
Light root and light copy produce lī
Prefix contact is evaluated at the addressed boundary
Auxiliary maps retain their own endings
Caṅ factors and all nine secondary endings

No grammar execution or full ID re-audit.
